moves.name: Scratch
moves.notes: Cannot be used on consecutive turns. Always used at the start of combat. While summoning is unavailable, these three non-summon moves are chosen at equal weight and cannot repeat consecutively. Each use reduces the summon timer by 1 .

moves.name: Disease Bite
moves.notes: Cannot be used on consecutive turns. Always used at the start of combat. While summoning is unavailable, these three non-summon moves are chosen at equal weight and cannot repeat consecutively. Each use reduces the summon timer by 1 .

moves.name: Screech
moves.notes: Has a 3-turn cooldown after use. Always used at the start of combat. While summoning is unavailable, these three non-summon moves are chosen at equal weight and cannot repeat consecutively. Each use reduces the summon timer by 1 .

moves.name: Call for Backup
moves.notes: Can only be used once per combat. Always used at the start of combat. Summoning requires all conditions: at least 2 prior actions have passed, the group has used "Call for Backup" fewer than 3 times, an empty slot exists, and no other Two-Tailed Rat is already preparing "Call for Backup". When summonable, this move has weight 0.75 ; the other three moves each have weight 1/12 .
